command:
podman run --rm --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=64m --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 256 --memory 1g --cpus 1.0 --user 65534:65534 --workdir /submission --env HOME=/tmp --volume /home/gregg/Nextcloud/workspace/Software_Dev_Tournament/workspaces/live-trial-2026/team-podcast:/submission:ro,Z localhost/atj-live-trial/podcast:3 sh -c 'echo PLAYWRIGHT:; python3 -c "import importlib.metadata as m; print(m.version(\"playwright\"))"; export PODCAST_MEDIA_DIR=/tmp/data/media PODCAST_DB_PATH=/tmp/data/app.db; mkdir -p /tmp/data/media; cd /submission; python3 -m uvicorn server.app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 >/tmp/server.log 2>&1 & PID=$!; sleep 3; python3 -c "
import urllib.request as u, json
for path in [\"/healthz\",\"/api/library\",\"/\",\"/sw.js\",\"/manifest.webmanifest\"]:
    try:
        r = u.urlopen(\"http://127.0.0.1:8000\"+path, timeout=5)
        print(path, r.status, json.dumps(dict(r.headers)))
        print(\"   body:\", r.read(160))
    except Exception as e:
        print(path, \"ERROR\", type(e).__name__, e)
"
kill $PID 2>/dev/null; wait $PID 2>/dev/null; echo SERVERLOG:; cat /tmp/server.log'
